purpose: Collect recent Jev, decision-model and System One papers from WeChat, Zhihu, Sina Weibo and X, then verify against original arXiv records and deduplicate.
recency: Queries targeted 2026-10-27 through 2026-10-30; discovery date is not paper submission date.

queries.query: site:weibo.com Jev 决策模型 OR System One 论文
site:x.com Jev TypeSafe decision model paper October 2026
Jev OpenAI Decisions Clef Korean US medical licensing exam arxiv decision models

outcomes.note: A web search following an X/Twitter medical-comparison lead surfaced MedJev (arXiv 2610.36006, first submitted 2026-10-26), which the four standing arXiv queries had missed because its title uses the hyphenated 'System-One' and the token 'MedJev'. The same day's arXiv API sweep (first submissions 2026-10-27 through 2026-10-30; nine unique fresh candidates after deduplication, several first submitted 10-27/10-28 but indexed only after the 2026-10-29 sweep ran) added 9 papers. Every other arXiv ID surfaced by social channels was already catalogued.
